status: Concrete reusable data and helper assertions. Proof status is recorded by the kernel dependency audit; later proof edits require current CI verification.

nodes.title: Explicit moment coefficient data
nodes.statement_tex: A coefficient family assigns a continuous symmetric k-linear form B_k^(j) to every pair of natural indices. IsMomentExpansion(mu,B) requires permutation symmetry and, for every k,q>=1, the operator-norm expansion b_(k,s)=sum_(j=1)^q s^j B_k^(j)/j!+o(s^q) as s decreases to zero through positive values. Degree vanishing and support identities are separate theorems.

nodes.title: Evaluation of the Bochner moment form
nodes.statement_tex: The kernel momentKernel(k,z) evaluates to the product of the inner products with z. If the Gaussian-weighted kernel is Bochner integrable, evaluation of gaussianMomentForm(mu,k,s) at a tuple equals the existing scalar gaussianMoment. The curried second-degree form momentBilinear(A) evaluates at (u,v) as A(u,v).
hypotheses: The weighted multilinear kernel is integrable for the integral-evaluation assertion.

nodes.title: Permutation symmetry of Gaussian moment forms
nodes.statement_tex: For every measure, degree, real Gaussian parameter, permutation sigma of Fin k, and tuple u, b_(k,s)(u composed with sigma)=b_(k,s)(u). The total Bochner definition is symmetric even when its integral takes the default zero value.

nodes.title: A common polynomial growth bound
nodes.statement_tex: HasPolynomialGrowthBound(mu,C,p) means C,p>=0 and mu(closedBall(0,R)) <= ofReal(C(1+R)^p) for every R>0. Families use the same finite real constants C,p.

nodes.title: Trace and restriction of continuous bilinear forms
nodes.statement_tex: For a continuous real bilinear form A on a finite-dimensional Euclidean space, bilinearTrace(A) is LinearMap.trace of the endomorphism obtained by Riesz representation. restrictBilinear(A,V) precomposes both variables with the subtype inclusion of V. momentBilinear curries a degree-two continuous multilinear form.

nodes.title: Trace as an orthonormal diagonal sum
nodes.statement_tex: For every finite orthonormal basis e, bilinearTrace(A)=sum_i A(e_i,e_i).

nodes.title: An admissible flatness cutoff
nodes.statement_tex: A continuous compactly supported real function phi is admissible if 0<=phi<=1, phi=1 on the closed unit ball, and its topological support is contained in the open ball of radius two.

nodes.title: Existence of an admissible cutoff
nodes.statement_tex: For every ambient Euclidean dimension there exists an admissible flatness cutoff.

nodes.title: A cutoff flatness gap threshold
nodes.statement_tex: IsFlatnessGap(m,phi,epsilon) means epsilon>0 and every centered unit m-uniform conical measure with cutoff flatness at most epsilon is flat.

nodes.title: Transfer the conical gap to cutoff flatness
nodes.statement_tex: For 1<=m<=n and an admissible cutoff phi, there exists epsilon such that IsFlatnessGap(m,phi,epsilon).

nodes.title: Quantified crossing scale data
nodes.statement_tex: FirstCrossingData records positive sigma_i<=r_i, r_i tending to zero, vague convergence of the r_i blow-ups to alpha and sigma_i blow-ups to xi, energy exactly epsilon at every sigma_i and at xi, and energy at most epsilon on every entire interval [sigma_i,r_i]. Divergence of r_i/sigma_i and flatness at infinity are separate theorems.

nodes.title: Continuity, homogeneity, and norm bound of moment kernels
nodes.statement_tex: The map z to momentKernel(k,z) is continuous, momentKernel(k,a z)=a^k momentKernel(k,z) for every real scalar a, and its operator norm is at most norm(z)^k. These assertions hold in every natural degree, including zero.

nodes.title: Integrability from summable annulus bounds
nodes.statement_tex: Let mu be a Borel measure on an arbitrary proper normed additive group E with finite mass on every positive-radius closed ball centered at zero. Let f be continuous and normed-additive-group valued. For nonnegative constants M_j, suppose norm(f(x))<=M_j whenever j<=norm(x)<=j+1. If sum_j M_j mu(closedBall(0,j+1)) is summable, then f is Bochner integrable.

nodes.title: Integral bound from a countable measurable cover
nodes.statement_tex: For any measure on any measurable space, a nonnegative integrable real function f, measurable sets S_j, and a summable real sequence B_j bounding integral_(S_j) f, the integral of f on the union of the S_j is at most sum_j B_j. Disjointification removes any overlap of the cover.

nodes.title: A summable common Gaussian annulus majorant
nodes.statement_tex: For C>=0, arbitrary real p, a natural degree d, and s>0, the sequence B_j=(j+1)^d exp(-s j^2) C(j+2)^p is summable. Bound the polynomial factor using ceil(p), use j^2>=j for natural j, and compare with a polynomial times the geometric series exp(-s)^j.

nodes.title: Gaussian integrals on unit annuli
nodes.statement_tex: If C>=0 and mu(closedBall(0,R))<=ofReal(C(1+R)^p) for all R>0, then for every natural j,d and s>0, the integral of norm(z)^d exp(-s norm(z)^2) over j<=norm(z)<=j+1 is at most (j+1)^d exp(-s j^2) C(j+2)^p. No regularity assumption is needed.

nodes.title: A common series controls every Gaussian tail
nodes.statement_tex: Under the same polynomial ball bound with C>=0, for every natural N and real R>=N, the Gaussian-polynomial integral outside closedBall(0,R) is at most sum_(j>=0) B_(j+N), where B_l=(l+1)^d exp(-s l^2) C(l+2)^p. The majorant is independent of the measure.
